title: What Plants Need to Grow
seo_title: Year 3 Science: What Plants Need to Grow Worksheets (Light, Water, Nutrients)
standard_text: Explore the requirements of plants for life and growth (air, light, water, nutrients from soil, and room to grow) and how they vary from plant to plant.
meta_desc: Free Year 3 science worksheets on what plants need to grow: light, water, air, nutrients, room and warmth, seeds, and simple plant growth tests. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Too little or too much of something can harm a plant.
body_html:
How to think about it

Plants need light, water, air, nutrients, room to grow and warmth.

  • Light lets leaves make food. Water and nutrients come in through the roots.
  • Too little or too much of something can harm a plant. Different plants need different amounts.
  • Seeds need water, warmth and air to start growing, but not light.
Example

A plant is pale and thin. Missing?

Pale and stretched

Answer: light

Example

Leaves droop, soil dry. Missing?

Drooping

Answer: water

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants get their food from the soil.
  • Thinking more water is always better.
  • Thinking seeds need light to start growing.

faq.q: What do plants need to grow?
faq.a: Plants need light, water, air, nutrients from the soil, room to grow and warmth.

faq.q: What happens to a plant with no light?
faq.a: It cannot make food. It grows tall, thin and pale as it stretches to find light, and in the end it dies.

faq.q: Do seeds need light to grow?
faq.a: Not at first. A seed needs water, warmth and air to start growing. It uses food stored inside it until its leaves grow and can use light.
